title: actinostachys confusa
intro: Actinostachys confusa, commonly known as the New Zealand fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Actinostachys confusa include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, making it a potential treatment for skin infections and other microbial-related conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
